cherry-desktop.description:
The cherry package manager and store client, the Cherry Center welcome and settings app,
desktop previews and switching, and double-click support for Windows programs.
cherry-desktop.name: cherry-desktop
cherry-desktop.summary: Cherry OS apps: Cherry Store, Cherry Center, desktop switcher, Windows app runner

cherry-move.description:
Cherry Move packs your documents, photos, browser data and more, encrypts them on your
computer, and keeps them on USB sticks, your own cloud drive or a NAS until the new one
brings them back.
cherry-move.name: cherry-move
cherry-move.summary: Move your files to a new computer or Linux distro

cherry-store-client.description:
Browse, install, update and remove apps from the Cherry Store. Every app is an
ordinary Debian package, signed by its publisher and virus-scanned, and installed
with apt. Includes the Cherry Store app and the cherry command, and keeps itself
up to date.
cherry-store-client.name: cherry-store-client
cherry-store-client.summary: Cherry Store: apps published by anyone, for Debian-based Linux

hello-cherry.description:
Says hello. It's here to show that publishing to and installing from
the Cherry Store works. Run 'hello-cherry' in a terminal or open it
from the menu.
hello-cherry.name: hello-cherry
hello-cherry.summary: A tiny test app for the Cherry Store
